reply.text:
Answer: Hi Vessa! I'd love to join your tool-sharing club — I've got a kitchen project coming up and could really use the tools. Could you send me the sign-up form? I'd like to start on August 1 and set up the monthly payments to come straight out of my account. Thanks so much! 

Note: Heads up — the club requires a 12-month minimum commitment ($360 total), but you'll only need it for two months, so you may want to check with Vessa about that before signing up.
